column2: Bring all four sheep into your flock.
Lead the flock to green pastures.
Lead the flock to still water.
Walk the righteous path after healing.
Guide the flock toward the pen as night falls.
Keep walking while wolves howl in the night.
Hear the table prepared in the presence of enemies.
Become the gate as the flock rests in the pen.
Hear the mystery at the fold.
Find your first Bible gem in the world.
Find every Bible gem in the world.
Finish the journey and hear the faithful servant blessing.
